input: I purchased the Starter plan 4 days ago. Can I get a full refund?
expected_output: Yes, customers on the Starter plan are eligible for a 100% full refund within 14 calendar days of initial purchase under our money-back guarantee.
context: All new customers on the Starter ($29/month) and Professional ($99/month) plans are eligible for a 100% full refund within 14 calendar days of their initial purchase, no questions asked.
Refunds are credited back to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

input: Can I get a refund on my Enterprise setup fee from 2 months ago?
expected_output: Enterprise plans with custom SLA agreements and one-time setup fees are strictly non-refundable.
context: Non-refundable: Enterprise plans with custom SLA agreements, one-time onboarding setup fees, and usage-based overage charges.
For cancellations after 14 days, service remains active until the end of the billing period; no partial or pro-rated cash refunds are issued.

input: How much does the Starter plan cost and how many seats do I get?
expected_output: The Starter Plan costs $29/month (or $290/year) and includes 5 active team seats and 10,000 monthly workflow executions.
context: Starter Plan ($29/month or $290/year) includes 5 active team seats, 10,000 monthly automation workflow executions, and standard email support.
Rate limit: 60 requests per minute on API endpoints.

input: What are the rate limits and features included in the Professional Plan?
expected_output: The Professional Plan is $99/month, offers 25 active team seats, 100,000 executions, priority support within 4 hours, CRM integrations, and an API rate limit of 300 requests per minute.
context: Professional Plan ($99/month or $990/year) includes 25 active team seats, 100,000 monthly automation workflow executions, priority email/Slack support within 4 business hours, and rate limit of 300 requests per minute.

input: URGENT: Our production webhooks are failing with 500 internal server errors across all endpoints!
expected_output: This has been classified as a P1 Critical Incident. A high-priority ticket has been created, our engineering team was alerted via Slack, and first response will be within 15 minutes.
context: If customers report 500 Internal Server Error, Connection Timeout, or failing webhooks, our engineering team flags this as a P1 (High Urgency) incident.
Priority 1 (Critical Outage): First response < 15 minutes, resolution target < 2 hours. Notification dispatched to #incident-alerts.

input: Our API requests are returning 401 Unauthorized with expired JWT tokens. How do we fix this?
expected_output: Clients must refresh expired JWT tokens using the /auth/refresh endpoint with a valid refresh token. API keys can also be rotated with zero downtime in Developer Dashboard.
context: Expired JWT tokens return 401 Unauthorized. Clients must refresh tokens using the /auth/refresh endpoint with their valid refresh token.
API keys can be rolled with zero downtime via the Developer Dashboard > Security > Rotate Key.

input: Do you offer an on-premise deployment option?
